item.title: [UPDATED] Learn about iCloud+ with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI
item.description:
Some Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features rely on powerful server-side models and have daily usage limits to ensure a high-quality, reliable experience for everyone. To increase your limits, you can upgrade your iCloud+ plan.

40 added · 12 removed

-# Learn about Apple Intelligence usage limits
+# Learn about iCloud+ with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI
-Some Apple Intelligence features rely on powerful server-side models and have usage limits to ensure a high-quality, reliable experience for everyone.
+Some Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features rely on powerful server-side models and have daily usage limits to ensure a high-quality, reliable experience for everyone. To increase your limits, you can upgrade your iCloud+ plan.
-Starting with the 2027 software releases, users can experience the next generation of Apple Intelligence, with enhanced access to features that rely on server-side models. These features include but aren't limited to:
+## Apple Intelligence and Siri AI feature categories
+
+Starting with the 2027 software releases, Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features are available for free for users with a supported device set to a supported language. Some features rely on powerful server models and have limits where increased access is available with eligible iCloud+ plans, starting with the 27.3 release. These include, but aren't limited to, features in these categories:
-- Intelligent Photo Editing Tools including Clean Up, Extend, and Spatial Reframing
+- Images: Intelligent Photo Editing Tools including Clean Up, Extend, and Spatial Reframing, and Image Playground
-- Image Playground
+- Workflows and automation: AFM Cloud and Cloud Pro models in Shortcuts
-- AFM 3 Cloud and AFM 3 Cloud Pro Models in Shortcuts
+- Third-party apps using Apple Foundation Models in Private Cloud Compute
-- Developer apps using Apple Foundation Models in Private Cloud Compute
+Apple implements daily usage limits on these feature categories and other features to ensure a high-quality, reliable experience for everyone. Limits may vary by feature category, request complexity, system demand, system policies, and other factors.
-In the future, Apple will implement usage limits on these and other Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features to ensure a high-quality, reliable experience for everyone. If you reach a limit in a particular feature, that feature will become available again after a time out period. Limits may vary by feature, request complexity, system demand, system policies, and other factors. Increased access to such features will be available for a fee.
+Some Apple Intelligence features in the Home app, such as video summaries, are available for a limited number of cameras: up to 1 camera in the 2 TB plan, up to 2 cameras in the 6 TB plan, and up to 5 cameras in the 12 TB plan.
-Some Apple Intelligence features in the Home app, such as video summaries, are available for a limited number of cameras depending on your iCloud+ plan — up to 1 camera in the 2 TB plan, up to 2 cameras in the 6 TB plan, and up to 5 cameras in the 12 TB plan. Supported camera counts and other iCloud+ plan features may change over time.
+## About the Siri AI limit
-Use of Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features will at all times be subject to the Apple Intelligence Terms and Conditions.
+Siri AI in the 2027 software releases is more capable, conversational, and personal, so you can get more done.
-[Learn more about Apple Intelligence usage terms](https://support.apple.com/en-us/148587)
+Siri AI includes a generous daily usage limit. If you reach it, you will be notified, and you can still make everyday Siri requests like "Set a timer for 3 minutes" or "Text Mark that Annika's party is at 123 Main Street.”
-Apple Intelligence features may not be available in all countries or regions. [Learn more about Apple Intelligence availability](https://support.apple.com/en-us/121115) .
+If you reach your limit, advanced requests are paused until your limit resets or you upgrade to an eligible iCloud+ plan. Advanced requests are more complex, like "Text Mark the address for Annika's party, and tell him what time we need to leave from home to make it on time" or "Add a summary of my San Francisco trip note to this email draft."
+
+## What happens when you hit your daily usage limit
+
+When you hit your daily usage limit for a particular feature category, you’ll be notified. Each device has its own daily usage limit per feature category. Once you reach a limit, you can wait until your daily usage limit resets on that device or immediately increase your limit by upgrading to an eligible iCloud+ plan.
+
+### When your daily usage limit resets
+
+All feature categories reset daily at the same time, and limits do not roll over to subsequent days. Your limit resets around midnight in your current time zone except:
+
+- If you’re traveling internationally, your limit resets around midnight in the central time zone of the country or region of your Apple Account.
+
+- If you share an iCloud+ plan with a Family Sharing group, your limit resets based on the time zone of the iCloud+ plan purchaser.
+
+- If you’re not signed in to your Apple Account on your device, your limit resets around 24 hours after you started using that feature category.
+
+## How to increase your Apple Intelligence and Siri AI daily usage limit
+
+For more access, upgrade to an iCloud+ plan with at least 200 GB of storage. After you reach your daily usage limit on a device, you gain access to an increased usage limit that is shared by all devices signed in to your Apple Account and across any Family members sharing your plan, on a first-come, first-served basis.
+
+| Free | iCloud+ with 50 GB | iCloud+ with 200 GB | iCloud+ with 2 TB | iCloud+ with 6 TB | iCloud+ with 12 TB
+
+Select Apple Intelligence Features and Siri AI | Standard Device Limit | Standard Device Limit | Up to 2X Standard Device Limit | Up to 5X Standard Device Limit | Up to 10X Standard Device Limit | Up to 20X Standard Device Limit
+
+Shortcuts using AFM Cloud Pro Model | - | - | Access to AFM Cloud Pro Model | Up to 5X Access | Up to 10X Access | Up to 20X Access
+
+Use of Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features is at all times subject to the [Apple Intelligence Usage Terms](https://support.apple.com/en-us/148587) . Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features may not be available in all countries or regions. Learn more about [Apple Intelligence availability](https://support.apple.com/en-us/121115) and [Siri AI availability](https://support.apple.com/en-us/127893) . Increased access to select Apple Intelligence features with iCloud+ is subject to Apple Intelligence availability and is not available in China, Brazil, the EU, UK, or South Korea. Increased access to Siri AI with iCloud+ is subject to Siri AI availability and is not available in Brazil, the EU, UK, or South Korea. Supported camera counts, the standard amount of Apple Intelligence and Siri AI access, and other iCloud+ plan features may change over time.

item.title: [UPDATED] iPhone Mirroring: Use your iPhone from your Mac
item.description:
With iPhone Mirroring, you can wirelessly interact with your iPhone and its apps and notifications from your Mac. Your iPhone stays locked, so no one else can access it or use it to see what you’re doing.

156 added · 0 removed

+- [iPhone Mirroring system requirements](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#requirements)
+
+- [Start or stop iPhone Mirroring](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#start)
+
+- [Interact with iPhone using iPhone Mirroring](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#interact)
+
+- [Move or resize the iPhone Mirroring window](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#move-or-resize)
+
+- [Manage iPhone notifications](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#notifications)
+
+- [Copy items between devices](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#copy)
+
+- [Change iPhone Mirroring settings](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#settings)
+
+- [If you need help](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#help)
+
+## iPhone Mirroring system requirements
+
+iPhone Mirroring can be used with only one Mac and one iPhone at a time. Your devices must meet these requirements:
+
+- Your Mac is using macOS Sequoia 15 or later and is a [Mac with Apple silicon](https://support.apple.com/en-us/116943) or [Mac with the Apple T2 Security Chip](https://support.apple.com/en-us/103265) . Live Activities on Mac requires macOS Tahoe 26 or later.
+
+- Your iPhone is using iOS 18 or later and is [set up to use a passcode](https://support.apple.com/en-us/119586) .
+
+- Your iPhone and Mac are [signed in to the same Apple Account](https://support.apple.com/en-us/111001) using [two-factor authentication](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102660) .
+
+- Your iPhone and Mac have Bluetooth and Wi-Fi turned on.
+
+- Your iPhone is locked and near your Mac. It can also be charging and [using StandBy](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/iph878d77632/ios) .
+
+- Your Mac is not [sharing its internet connection](https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/mchlp1540/mac) or using [AirPlay](https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/mchld7e543a0/mac) or [Sidecar](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102597) .
+
+iPhone Mirroring is currently unavailable in the European Union. To simply view but not interact with your iPhone screen or its streamed video on an AirPlay-compatible device, you can [use AirPlay](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102661) instead.
+
+## Start or stop iPhone Mirroring
+
+- On your Mac, click iPhone Mirroring in the Dock. Or open it from the Applications folder or Spotlight or Siri AI . It's included with macOS Sequoia 15 or later.
+
+- If your Mac asks you to unlock your iPhone, use your iPhone to enter your iPhone passcode.
+
+- If your Mac asks whether to allow notifications from your iPhone, click Allow or Don’t Allow. You can change this later in [Notifications settings](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#notifications) on your Mac.
+
+- If your Mac asks whether to require Mac login to access your iPhone, choose whether to be asked every time or to authenticate automatically. You can change this later in [iPhone Mirroring settings](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#settings) .
+
+- When iPhone Mirroring shows your iPhone screen, it’s connected to your iPhone and you can use it to interact with your iPhone. [Can’t connect to your iPhone?](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#help)
+
+- To stop mirroring your iPhone, quit the iPhone Mirroring app or unlock your iPhone.
+
+If you have more than one iPhone signed in to your Apple Account and nearby, you can [choose the iPhone that your Mac uses](https://support.apple.com/en-us/120421#choose-iphone) for mirroring and iPhone notifications.
+
+
+Privacy & Security: iPhone Mirroring automatically pauses the connection after periods of inactivity. While mirroring, your iPhone says that it's in use and identifies the Mac using it. When unlocked after mirroring, it says that it was used from a Mac and links to Settings > General > AirPlay & Continuity > iPhone Mirroring, which identifies the Mac that used your iPhone, including when and for how long.
+
+## Interact with iPhone using iPhone Mirroring
+
+Tap, swipe, and type | Use your Mac mouse or trackpad to click wherever you would tap on your iPhone. Or click and hold wherever you would touch and hold, such as to edit the Home Screen or open a quick actions menu . You can scroll or swipe with your mouse or trackpad, and use your Mac keyboard to type and use keyboard shortcuts. To swipe left or right, you can also press and hold the Shift key while scrolling. To use a wireless game controller with iPhone apps that support it, use Bluetooth to connect the controller to your iPhone instead of your Mac.
+
+Go to the Home Screen | Move the pointer to the top of the iPhone Mirroring window, then click the Home Screen button in the toolbar. Or click the bar at the bottom of the iPhone Mirroring window. Or press Command-1 on your keyboard.
+
+Open the App Switcher | Move the pointer to the top of the iPhone Mirroring window, then click the App Switcher button in the toolbar. Or press Command-2 on your keyboard.
+
+Open Spotlight | Click the Search field at the bottom of the Home Screen in iPhone Mirroring. Or press Command-3 on your keyboard.
+
+Open Control Center | Press Command-4 on your keyboard. (Requires macOS 27 or later.)
+
+Play audio or video | iPhone audio plays through your Mac, and your Mac controls the volume, unless you're listening through headphones connected to your iPhone. iPhone video plays back in the iPhone Mirroring window. Streaming content providers might have playback restriction policies that affect whether their premium video content can be mirrored.
+
+Access to the iPhone camera and mic is not available in iPhone Mirroring, including for Face ID or phone calls. You can [make and receive phone calls on your Mac](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102405) instead. To make calls from your Mac while iPhone Mirroring is in use, both devices must have [Wi-Fi Calling turned on](https://support.apple.com/en-us/108066) .
+
+## Move or resize the iPhone Mirroring window
+
+To change the position of the iPhone Mirroring window, move the pointer to the top of the window, then drag the window by the toolbar that appears.
+
+To change the size of the iPhone Mirroring window:
+
+- Use the View menu in the menu bar to choose from three preset sizes: Larger, Smaller, or Actual Size. Or press Command–Plus sign (+), Command–Minus sign (–), or Command-0 to switch between sizes.
+
+- In macOS 27 or later, you can drag a corner of the iPhone Mirroring window to resize it. Some apps, such as Mail, Messages, and Calendar, are designed to show more information when you drag to make the window wider. You can then return to standard iPhone size by clicking the iPhone size button in the iPhone Mirroring toolbar, or by pressing Command-9.
+
+iPhone Mirroring automatically switches to and from landscape view as required by the app that you’re using.
